part.text:
P0 | seg_origin_run.py, `ORIGIN = 300` | Registration (and both file docstrings) fix segments at rows [200+500k, 700+500k) with the 200 prefix rows entering no segment; the patch sets `self.closed = 300`, so the first segment is [300, 800), which crosses the concept boundary at row 700 on blk=500 streams (and [1800, 2300) crosses 2200 on blk=2000), leaving stored segments impure and defeating the diagnostic's premise | Set `ORIGIN = 200` so segments are [200+500k, 700+500k).
P0 | check_seg_origin.py, `r[f"C_hist{k}"] = r[f"P_d_ddm{k}"] - r[f"O_d_ddm{k}"]` | Registration defines C_hist = P − A (pure segments, 200-row history), but the code computes P − O, identical to the C_imp line above it (its own docstring also says C_hist = P − A), so H3 would test the impurity contrast — which H2 expects to be ≥ +5.0 — instead of the history contrast | Compute C_hist as `r[f"P_d_ddm{k}"] - r[f"A_d_ddm{k}"]`.
P0 | check_seg_origin.py, `P=policies(f"{RUN}/P", f"{RUN}/P", f"{CTRL}/off", of, t + 1)[0]` | P runs use the same offset streams as O and registration requires 4.b matched batches (offset batch t+2 = aligned batch t); O indexes at `t + SHIFT` (t+2) but P indexes at t+1, so P's MICE/archive series and its DDM read are sampled one batch early, and the guard `assert np.array_equal(pol["O"]["ddm"], pol["P"]["ddm"])` compares acc[t+2] vs acc[t+1] of the same DDM file and will fail (without the assert, C_imp/C_hist would be computed on unmatched batches) | Index P with `t + SHIFT`.
P1 | check_seg_origin.py, H1 verdict `"HOLDS" if pos >= 6 and mean >= 1.0` | Registration H1 requires MICE − DDM positive on ≥ 7 of 8 streams (check_offset.py's 4.b criterion also states ≥ 7 of 8); the code accepts 6 of 8, so H1 can print HOLDS when the registered criterion fails | Use `pos >= 7`.
P1 | check_seg_origin.py, H3 verdict `"HOLDS" if m.C_hist.abs().mean() <= 1.0` | Registration H3 is |mean C_hist| ≤ 1.0 (absolute of the mean); the code gates on the mean of per-stream absolute values, a different and stricter criterion (the same line even prints `m.C_hist.mean()` as the reported value) | Gate on `abs(m.C_hist.mean()) <= 1.0`.
P2 | seg_origin_run.py, `run.run(s, m, 100, f"{RUN}/P")` with run.run's `if os.path.exists(dst): return` | After correcting ORIGIN, any npz outputs already written under ~/pfn-runs/mice_seg_origin_r12 by the ORIGIN=300 version would be silently reused instead of recomputed | Purge (or verify absence of) `RUN/P` outputs produced before the ORIGIN fix, then rerun.
